user.title: Set up Linux Timekpra
user.description: Configure SSH connection to your Linux PC running Timekpra to manage screen time.

data.auto_search_ip: Automatically find the PC if its IP changes

data_description.ssh_host: IP address or hostname of your Linux PC (e.g., 192.0.2.10 or pc.local)
data_description.ssh_key_path: Path to SSH private key file (e.g., /config/.ssh/id_ed25519)
data_description.mac_address: Required for automatic IP rediscovery. Enter the wired or Wi-Fi MAC address used by the PC.
data_description.auto_search_ip: Search the local network for the configured MAC address after SSH connection failures.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll for screen time status (in seconds). Default is 30.
data_description.command_path: Path to timekpra commands on remote host. Default is /usr/local/bin/ha_timekpra

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to SSH host. Check host, username, and key path.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a valid MAC address, such as 00:11:22:AA:BB:CC.
error.invalid_key: SSH key file not found or invalid.
error.command_failed: Failed to execute timekpra command on remote host.
